title: Adjusting for Confounders with Text: Challenges and an Empirical Evaluation Framework for Causal Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating causal inference models on semi-synthetic text datasets with known confounding variables by calculating the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) bias (the difference between the model's estimated ATE and the known true ATE).

Varying the treatment and control assignment probabilities among different user classes to test the models' ability to adjust for strong selection effects (where treated and untreated groups have very limited overlap).
Applying causal inference estimators to a real-world observational dataset to measure the causal effect of an author's inferred gender on the score (upvotes minus downvotes) of their Reddit posts.
